comparison.objective: Keep a lock key turned while pulling a drawer open.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual sustained rotation and simultaneous pulling, not iterative parameter adjustment or torque-bounded relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Quarter-turn held until drawer motion begins. Angle tolerance, opening distance, and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Shared rotation and bimanual coordination are generic; the sustained interlock operation is different.
